title: i18n(platform-objects): ship the platform objects, Setup, Studio and Account in French
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiR7jUqx4egncChjbUD2S9oH)_

Part of #30512
Fixes #28107
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么：给 `@objectstack/platform-objects` 加上法语（fr）：平台对象、Studio 的元数据表单、Setup/Studio/Account 导航、系统概览仪表板和用户/组织记录页的内嵌文字，做法与刚合并的 ar（#31120）逐文件一致。
- 为什么改：语言设为 fr 的用户在主页动态里读到「A modifié User « … » : Banned et Ban Reason」，法语句子里夹着英文字段名（#28107）；fr 也是 #30512 要补的第三个语言。
- 风险与回滚：只新增 fr 文件、注册行和测试里的语言列表，不改任何已有语言的文字；新文字同样走 source-hash 回退。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/fr.ts`（导航钉住项），`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/activity-summary-fr-sys-user-labels.test.ts`（#28107 的守护测试），`fr.metadata-forms.generated.ts` 里 repeater 行属性那几处带上父名的译法。
- 两分钟验证：`cd packages/plugins/plugin-audit && npx vitest run src/activity-summary-fr-sys-user-labels.test.ts`，预期 5 个测试通过，句子为「A modifié Utilisateur « Carl Edited » : Banni et Motif du bannissement」。
- 需要你做的：生成文件让 PR 超过 3000 行，座位契约复审 ACCEPT 后请人工合并。

## What changes
- New `fr` bundles in `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations`: `fr.objects.generated.ts` (1697 leaves), `fr.metadata-forms.generated.ts` (1263 leaves), their provenance table `fr.source-hashes.generated.ts` (183 deliberate byte copies of `en`, listed under Acceptance notes), the hand-authored `fr.ts` (140 leaves) and `fr.source-hashes.ts` recording the `en` digest of every hand leaf.
- Registration: the extract config's `--locales` docstring and `translations:` baseline, `setup.translation.ts`, the `apps` barrel, and `metadata-translations/index.ts`.
- Inline maps: 36 in `sys-user.page.ts`, 6 in `sys-organization.page.ts`, and the System Overview null label in `system.datasets.ts`.
- Wording pins: `nav_account_approvals` reads as plugin-approvals' `my_pending` label (`Mes approbations en attente`), `nav_assignment_rules` as `sys_assignment_rule`'s plural label (`Règles d’attribution`), each `nav_settings_*` (including `nav_settings_access_policy`) as its service-settings hub title, `nav_settings_hub` as the console's `backToHub` (`Tous les paramètres`), and the four #30935 keys: `grp_account_ai_assistant` = `Assistant IA`; both `nav_connect_agent` entries and `pages.connect_agent.label` = `Connecter un assistant IA`.
- `fr.source-hashes.ts` also records `nav_settings_access_policy`, which the `ar` and `zh-Hant` tables leave legacy-trusted.
- Changeset `.changeset/30512-platform-objects-fr.md` (patch).

## Tests
- `fr` added to the locale lists of every test #31120 widened for `ar` (vocabulary, nav parity, dead-key tombstone, source-hash, copy tests, record-page tabs, plugin translation loads), plus plugin-approvals `approval-status-vocabulary`, plugin-security `people-org-assignment-nav-contribution` and service-settings `setup-nav-hub-parity`. The cli `platform-page-i18n-parity` LOCALE_KEY shape already accepts `fr`.
- New `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/activity-summary-fr-sys-user-labels.test.ts` (#28107): an i18n service holding what a booted kernel holds (this plugin's bundle and the platform Setup bundle, every locale) composes a `sys_user` update summary for a reader whose locale is `fr` or `fr-FR`. The reader gets `A modifié Utilisateur « Carl Edited » : Banni et Motif du bannissement`, and a tracked change names `Motif du bannissement`; an `en` control keeps `Updated User "Carl Edited": Banned and Ban Reason`. Ablation: with the platform `fr` bundle left out of the service, three cases fail with `A modifié User « Carl Edited » : Banned et Ban Reason`, the sentence #28107 reported.

## Acceptance notes
- Every leaf is translated. The 183 byte copies of `en` the extract records are French words spelled like the English (`Description`, `Type`, `Source`, `Version`, `Navigation`, `Configuration`, `Kanban`, …), identifiers and header names (`ID`, `API`, `JWKS`, `JWKS URI`, `Message-ID`, `Reply-To`, `Cc`, `cron`, `snake_case`), lowercase option values that read the same in French (`marketing`, `notification`, `workflow`, `package`), and the five JSON or scope examples kept verbatim as every locale keeps them.
- Where a catalog test refuses an `en` echo (repeater row properties, dashboard header children, System Overview captions), the leaf names its parent instead (`ID du nœud`, `Description de l’option`, `Type de variable`, `Boutons d’action`, `Nombre de sessions`), as `es-ES` does.
- Typography follows `ui/packages/i18n` `fr`: a plain space before `: ; ? !`, plain spaces inside « », the typographic apostrophe, sentence case.
- `Position` on the add-record button is `Position` (the place); the job position is `Poste`. A hook's `Body` is `Corps`. Adjectives agree with the object they qualify (`Toutes`, `Révoquées`, `Désactivée`, …).
- Business units are `Unités commerciales`; no `sys_business_unit*` label says `Département` (`bu-rename-consistency`).

## Verification
- `os i18n extract packages/platform-objects/scripts/i18n-extract.config.ts --locales=zh-CN,ja-JP,es-ES,zh-Hant,ar,fr --fill=default --source-hashes`: regenerates the two `fr` bundles byte-identical and leaves every other locale unchanged, before and after the merge of `origin/main`.
- `vitest run` in platform-objects: 119 files, 1746 tests passed. plugin-approvals `approval-status-vocabulary` (6), plugin-security `people-org-assignment-nav-contribution` (5), service-settings `setup-nav-hub-parity` (15), cli `platform-page-i18n-parity` (27) and the new plugin-audit test (5) passed.
- platform-objects `typecheck`: exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates --ran` at dd9303ac (after the merge of `origin/main`): 64 derived families, 64 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, all exit 0 (including `check:i18n`, `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`).
- `pnpm lint`: exit 0. "Lint · docs & code guards" lane: 52 of its 53 run steps exit 0 locally (including `check:i18n-stale-fill` and `check:cli-command-ids`); the 53rd is `lane-verdict.mjs`, which reads `GITHUB_JOB` and only measures in CI.
